tests.name: wrong /cmd_vel had publisher and zero subscribers
fixed /turtle1/cmd_vel had publisher and turtlesim subscriber

defect.reproducer: Published geometry_msgs/msg/Twist to /cmd_vel with --rate 1; ros2 topic info /cmd_vel --verbose showed Publisher count: 1 and Subscription count: 0, and the turtle did not move.
defect.root_cause: The message type was correct, but turtlesim subscribes to /turtle1/cmd_vel, not /cmd_vel. Topic discovery alone does not imply delivery to the intended subscriber.
defect.proof_after: Changed only the topic name to /turtle1/cmd_vel. ros2 topic info showed Publisher count: 1 and Subscription count: 1 for turtlesim, and the turtle moved.
